name: Editorial Fashion
tagline: High-fashion looks with bold light and real attitude.
description: Portfolio-grade fashion stories: oversized tailoring, color blocking, wind-machine movement, gel-lit blinds, desert couture, chunky knit campaigns, hard flash on black and a sweeping monochrome suit. Strong poses and art-directed light for a model or creative portfolio.
